title: Time Slips Away
style: Hyper-kinetic electronic rush at 175 BPM with chopped breakbeats, overclocked 808 kick, rubbery sub-bass, and razor-sharp hat stutters. Glitch edits, staccato synth arpeggios, distorted bass pulses, tape-stop cuts, and frantic sidechained layers stack into a dense, breathless mix that constantly surges and fractures.
lyrics:
[Verse]
Time slips away
Time slips away
Every tick of the clock
And the pulse
As I rip it all to bits
Time slips away

[Chorus]
I take the time
I take all the time
Time is now
Time is only now
[Verse]
Every moment
Every moment
Spun into meaning
Spun into something
Something to believe in
[Chorus]
I wish for you
Not for me
I wish that your wishes
All come true
All my wishes
All my wishes came true
Every moment
Every moment
Just like you
[Bridge]
I wanna know
I wanna know
What makes it last?
Why does it go so fast?
Where does it go?
Is it here?
Or is it there?
Is it anywhere?
Was I just told?
Was I born and told?
Born and told
[Pre-Chorus]
You're out of time
[Chorus]
Out of time
[Pre-Chorus]
What's time?
[Chorus]
It's slipping away
It's slipping away
[Verse]
[whispered vocals]
[Verse]
Time is time
Time is time
It's in the beat
It's in the music
It's where we meet
It's all around
[Pre-Chorus]
All the time
[Chorus]
All the time
[Verse]
Just tell me straight
Right to my face
What is this race?
I race time
And it's mine
[Bridge]
Live for each moment
Say it now
There is only now
Wait and it's too late
Say it before you pass on by
